description: Identify the most likely algorithms behind a hash string from its length, character set and any prefix. Covers MD5, NTLM, MD4, SHA-1, RIPEMD-160, SHA-224/256/384/512, the SHA3 family, CRC32, bcrypt, Argon2, sha512crypt, sha256crypt and md5crypt, plus Base64 length hints. A hash does not carry its algorithm, so results are ranked best guesses, not proof. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/hash-identifier/
name: hopi_hash_identifier
